_doc: D-80 oracle request manifest — the implementation-independent statement of every oracle probe request and the recursive shape of its answer. Immutable except by ADJUDICATED update (see btap-necb/docs/necb_decisions.md D-80).

bootstrap_provenance.note: schedule_names and costing_candidates were derived ONCE from the gem data (the last gem-derived act); golden_inventory from the committed goldens exported at the pinned oracle. source_hashes is a HISTORICAL record of that one-time bootstrap — deliberately NOT compared against current gem data by any test: the request inventory is independently frozen here, and current-source drift is irrelevant to it. A legitimate inventory change is an adjudicated manifest update, not a re-bootstrap.
